body:
> However if the count for a line is 0, I currently didn't add a specific classname for it. Do you want this to be added ?

I would say yes, since the current starRating widget has this ability (see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1317#issuecomment-248616488), and it is very valuable. If the range is not relevant then we should hint the display/user. (Like a disabled state, or something consistent with Pagination for example)

What do you think?
